notes: Checked 2026-10-26 on AsiaTVDrama embeds (hgcloud.to/e/ID, dhcplay.com/e/ID). Those pages are only a loader whose script picks a player domain; the player, audinifer.com/e/ID (same ID), holds a packed script naming the HLS playlist. So Sahra asks audinifer.com for the same /e/ID path directly. HTML (a packed script), no API. When StreamHG moves its player to a new domain, change audinifer.com in the first step and add the domain to hosts.
